summary_zh: 我們很高興地宣布，2025年照亮雨林計劃即將啟動！今年我們將有30多名志願者前往馬來西亞婆羅洲雨林，為當地的本南人村落安裝太陽能供電系統。
summary_en: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of our 2025 Rainforest Expedition! This year, 30+ volunteers will travel to the Borneo rainforest in Malaysia to install solar power systems for local Penan communities.
summary2_zh: 這次行動除了安裝太陽能板外，我們還將進行雨林保育宣導，並與當地社區分享環保知識。這將是我們有史以來規模最大的一次行動。
summary2_en: The expedition includes solar panel installations, rainforest conservation workshops, and environmental education programs with local communities. This marks our largest expedition to date.
content_zh:
我們非常高興地宣布，2025年照亮雨林計劃已正式啟動。本次行動為期兩週，將於 2025 年 7 月 5 日至 7 月 19 日進行，除了太陽能設備安裝，也包含在地社區工作坊。

我們的目標是為三個偏遠本南村落建立可持續供電，並訓練居民維護太陽能系統，提升社區環境保護意識，建立長期合作關係。

每一筆支持都將投入太陽能設備與培訓資源，讓更多家庭獲得穩定照明與更好的學習生活環境。
content_en:
We are thrilled to officially launch the 2025 Illuminating Rainforest Project. This two-week mission runs from July 5 to July 19, 2025, and includes both solar power installation and local community workshops.

Our goal is to provide sustainable electricity for three remote Penan villages, train residents to maintain the systems, increase environmental awareness, and build long-term partnerships.

Every contribution supports solar equipment and training resources, helping more families gain stable lighting and better learning and living conditions.

title_zh: 照亮雨林計畫獲 Eco Echo Award 綠獎青年行動獎優選
title_en: Illuminating Rainforest Project Receives Eco Echo Award (Green Awards) – Youth Action Award (Top Winner)
summary_zh: 「照亮雨林計畫」於第十屆 Eco Echo Award（綠獎）獲得「青年行動獎優選」。本計畫以再生能源導入偏遠社區為核心，透過技術與社區合作改善雨林地區能源取得不穩定的問題。
summary_en: The Illuminating Rainforest Project received the Youth Action Award (Top Winner) at the 10th Eco Echo Award (Green Awards). The project focuses on introducing renewable energy to remote communities and improving unstable access to energy through technology and community collaboration.
summary2_zh: 發布日期：2025/10/31 / 類別：專案成果 / 獲獎
content_zh:
「照亮雨林計畫」於第十屆 Eco Echo Award（綠獎）中，獲得青年行動獎優選的肯定。

此獎項主要表彰以實際行動回應環境與永續議題的青年團隊。計畫以「再生能源導入偏遠社區」為核心，透過技術與社區合作模式，改善雨林地區能源取得不穩定的問題。

本計畫主要在馬來西亞砂拉越雨林地區推動。當地部分村落過去依賴柴油發電機或缺乏穩定電力來源，不僅成本高，也對環境造成負擔。團隊導入小型太陽能離網系統（Solar Off-Grid System），建立社區共享能源架構，使村落能在夜間獲得基本照明與電力支持。

在技術執行上，計畫包含：太陽能板與儲能電池系統部署、社區能源共享機制建立、當地居民設備維護培訓，以及永續教育與環境意識推廣。透過這些措施，村落逐步降低對柴油能源的依賴，同時提升生活品質與安全性。

夜間照明的建立，也讓教育、社區活動與基本醫療需求更容易進行。此次獲得 Eco Echo Award 的肯定，代表此計畫在環境永續（Sustainability）與社會影響力（Social Impact）面向獲得專業評審認可，並為未來擴展更多雨林社區奠定基礎。

相關資料：https://ecoechoaward.com/portfolio-item/2025-%E7%85%A7%E4%BA%AE%E9%9B%A8%E6%9E%97%E8%A8%88%E7%95%AB/
content_en:
The Illuminating Rainforest Project received a Youth Action Award (Top Winner) at the 10th Eco Echo Award (Green Awards).

This award recognizes youth teams that respond to environmental and sustainability issues through real action. The project focuses on introducing renewable energy to remote communities, using a technology-and-community collaboration model to improve unstable energy access in rainforest areas.

The project is primarily implemented in the rainforest regions of Sarawak, Malaysia. In some villages, electricity has previously relied on diesel generators or lacked stable power sources, which is not only costly but also creates environmental burdens. The team introduced small solar off-grid systems and established a community-shared energy model, enabling basic lighting and power support at night.

In terms of technical implementation, the project includes solar panel and energy storage deployment, building a community energy-sharing mechanism, training local residents to maintain the equipment, and promoting sustainability education and environmental awareness. These measures help villages gradually reduce reliance on diesel energy while improving quality of life and safety.

With night-time lighting in place, education, community activities, and basic healthcare needs can be carried out more easily. This Eco Echo Award recognition highlights the project’s sustainability and social impact, and also lays a foundation for expanding to more rainforest communities in the future.

Reference: https://ecoechoaward.com/portfolio-item/2025-%E7%85%A7%E4%BA%AE%E9%9B%A8%E6%9E%97%E8%A8%88%E7%95%AB/

title_zh: 照亮雨林計畫榮獲金車文教基金會「愛轉動世界」全球議題組優選
title_en: Illuminating Rainforest Project Wins King Car Foundation's 'Love Turns the World' Global Issues Group Award (Top Winner)
summary_zh: 「照亮雨林計畫」在金車文教基金會主辦的「愛轉動世界」計畫中，獲得全球議題組優選。計畫聚焦青年回應環境、教育與永續發展挑戰，透過實地行動與跨國合作協助偏遠地區建立可持續能源系統。
summary_en: The Illuminating Rainforest Project was awarded a Top Winner in the Global Issues Group under the King Car Foundation’s “Love Turns the World” program. The program encourages youth to respond to challenges in environment, education, and sustainable development through real action and cross-border collaboration to build sustainable energy systems in remote areas.
summary2_zh: 發布日期：2025/07/05 / 類別：專案成果 / 國際議題
summary2_en: Published: 2025/07/05 / Category: Project Outcomes / International Issues
content_zh:
「照亮雨林計畫」同時在金車文教基金會主辦的「愛轉動世界」計畫中，獲得全球議題組優選。

本計畫聚焦於青年關注國際發展議題，鼓勵透過實際行動回應環境、教育與永續發展挑戰。

專案以雨林永續發展與能源公平（Energy Equity）為核心議題，透過跨國合作與實地行動，協助偏遠地區建立可持續的能源系統。除了技術導入外，團隊也規劃教育與文化交流活動，使計畫不只是設備建設，而能成為長期的社區合作模式。

專案主要內容包括：建立太陽能共享能源系統、辦理雨林兒童教育營、推動環境教育與能源知識普及，以及促進台灣與當地社區的交流合作。

這類型的計畫可被視為社會創新與永續發展實踐（SDGs Implementation）的案例。透過青年團隊的行動，不僅改善基礎能源問題，也讓更多人關注熱帶雨林地區的生活與環境議題。

未來，「照亮雨林計畫」也將持續擴展影響範圍，並探索更多與地方社群合作的可能性，使能源、教育與環境保護能夠同步推進。

相關資料：https://kingcar.org.tw/upload/502069
content_en:
The Illuminating Rainforest Project also received a Top Winner in the Global Issues Group under the King Car Foundation’s “Love Turns the World” program.

The program focuses on youth engagement with international development topics and encourages participants to respond to challenges in the areas of environment, education, and sustainable development through real-world action.

This project centers on rainforest sustainable development and energy equity. Through cross-border collaboration and on-site implementation, it helps remote areas establish sustainable energy systems. Beyond technology installation, the team also plans education and cultural exchange activities, ensuring the project becomes a long-term community partnership rather than a one-time equipment effort.

Key components include building a solar shared-energy system, organizing rainforest children’s education camps, promoting environmental education and energy knowledge, and strengthening exchange and cooperation between Taiwan and local communities.

Initiatives like this represent social innovation and SDGs implementation in the international development field. Through youth-led action, the project not only improves basic energy access, but also draws greater attention to daily life and environmental issues in tropical rainforest regions.

Looking ahead, the Illuminating Rainforest Project will continue to expand its impact and explore more partnership possibilities with local communities, so that energy, education, and environmental protection can move forward together.

Reference: https://kingcar.org.tw/upload/502069
